TransWork Happy Hour Networking at Val's Lesbian Bar

Event Details

November 10, 2026 - 4:00pm

Join TransWork for an evening of free and no-stress networking and connections to inclusive resources for job-seekers, entrepreneurs, and all people who are trying to get by and pay our bills. Feel free your resume or cover letter to get personalized feedback in a one-on-one meeting, come with questions about interviewing or other job-search topics, and/or just show up to meet cool people! Registration is not required but helps us to anticipate how many people are coming https://members.thinkiba.com/ap/Events/Register/lzFm3V5UjC5Cw . 

Please contact transwork@thinkiba.com with any questions! Thank you!

 

Event Details: TransWork Happy Hour Networking at Val's Lesbian Bar

November 10, 4-6pm

21+ with valid ID

Val's is at 605 S 3rd St, Philadelphia PA, 19147
